tips.title: Define CAM-Part name and location
tips.body: Create a new CAM-Part in InventorCAM, specifying a name and location.

tips.title: Select CNC-controller and define Coordinate System
tips.body: Choose the appropriate CNC-controller, set up a Coordinate System, and define stock/target boundaries.

tips.title: Set up Machine Setup for part positioning
tips.body: Define the position of the part with respect to the machine table and add fixtures.

tips.title: Create Perpendicular to Curve strategy tool path
tips.body: Select the drive surface and lead curve, then create a tool path perpendicular to the lead curve.

tips.title: Define Limit Cuts Between Two Points
tips.body: Set the limit cuts between two points and define margins for the tool path.

tips.title: Select Tool and Holder for Milling Operation
tips.body: Choose the appropriate tool (LOLLIPOP MILL) and holder (BT 40 ER 32X60) for the milling operation.

tips.title: Configure Tool Path Parameters
tips.body: Set tool path parameters such as sorting and tilt direction for the milling operation.

tips.title: Define Tilt Curve for Tool Axis Control
tips.body: Select the tilt curve and ensure it is set from top to bottom for the tool axis direction.

tips.title: Use 'From start to end' tilt type for port machining
tips.body: This ensures the tool axis follows the tilt curve from start to end, reducing gouging risk.

tips.title: Enable Gouge check and select 'Retract tool and Along to cut center'
tips.body: This strategy helps prevent gouging by retracting the tool along the cut center.

tips.title: Use 'Back to clearance through tube center' for tool retraction
tips.body: This option ensures the tool retracts safely without causing gouges.

tips.title: Set Interpolation for distance to 5
tips.body: This value helps in achieving smooth tool paths during machining.

tips.title: Use 'Morph between two boundary curves' for tool path creation
tips.body: This option creates a smooth transition between two boundary curves, reducing tool stress.

tips.title: Limit cuts by one or two points for precise control
tips.body: This allows for more accurate and controlled machining of specific areas.

tips.title: Set Cut tolerance to 0.01 for high precision
tips.body: This ensures the tool path adheres closely to the geometry, improving finish quality.

tips.title: Use 'Spiral' cutting method for smooth tool paths
tips.body: This method helps in achieving smoother and more efficient machining.

tips.title: Set Clearance area type as Plane and Plane height as 10 mm
tips.body: This ensures the tool has enough clearance for safe operation.

tips.title: Use 'Octa_Port' surface for gouge checking
tips.body: This helps in identifying and removing any potential gouges during machining.
